pages.body:
How the agent works for me, and what it should know before it acts.

pages.title: Brief 2026-11-16

- **Field Guide**: spec Tuesday, design review Monday 14:00, release notes for 0.4 by Wednesday. Twenty beta invites go out once the notes are written ([[topics/beta-testers]]).

pages.title: Ship the Field Guide app
pages.body:
A field guide to the trees and birds of the Bay Area that works with no signal.

## Why
Every guide app fails on the trail, where it is needed.

## Now
- [[projects/offline-maps]]: the spec is due tomorrow.
- [[topics/beta-testers]]: twenty people by the end of the month.

## Done means
Public beta in the store, a hundred weekly users, crash-free rate over 99%.

pages.title: Overnight oats
pages.body: Half a cup of oats, half a cup of milk, a spoon of yoghurt, chia, a pinch of salt. Fruit in the morning. The pre-long-run breakfast for [[goals/half-marathon]].

pages.title: Shakshuka
pages.body:
For two.

1. Soften an onion and a red pepper in olive oil.
2. Add garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, then a tin of tomatoes.
3. Simmer ten minutes, make four wells, crack in eggs.
4. Lid on, five minutes. Feta and parsley on top.

pages.title: Vector tile providers
pages.body:
Compared for [[projects/offline-maps]].

- **Provider A**: generous free tier, offline packs allowed, styles are dated.
- **Provider B**: best styles, offline use needs the enterprise plan.
- **Self-hosted**: OpenStreetMap extracts, more work, no limits.

Leaning self-hosted; [[people/daniel-reyes]] agrees.
